- name: Download vulnerability database through runner network
# When every download attempt fails, a cached database built within
# this many hours is still used, with a warning. Older or missing
# databases fail the job as before.
# Only the pinned scanner and its cache use the runner network. No
# checkout or Docker socket is mounted during this download. A host
# loopback proxy is otherwise unreachable from the container bridge.
echo "Cached vulnerability database is current; no download needed."
# Trivy deletes the cached metadata before it downloads, so a failed
# in-place download destroys the last good database. Download into a
# per-run staging cache and swap it in only after success. The cache
# is root-owned by the container, so file operations run in it too.
# Also drop staging caches abandoned by cancelled runs.
for repository in ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy-db:2 mirror.gcr.io/aquasec/trivy-db:2; do
echo "::warning title=Trivy DB download failed::Using the cached vulnerability database built ${age_hours}h ago (limit ${TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS}h)."
echo "::error title=Trivy DB download failed::Cached vulnerability database is ${age_hours}h old, over the ${TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS}h fallback limit."
echo "::error title=Trivy DB download failed::No usable cached vulnerability database."
# The previous step prepared the database; never re-download here.

# name. contract-placement is never relayed: this job runs PR code, so App 5368905 always publishes the
# required contract-placement check from its formal local role, whatever this run concludes.
# Candidate PR code never runs on the controller secret-bearing principal.
# Owner Decision 22b0e0ed: admit on the independent CI's own App 5368905 kooyumi-work-admission
# check for this exact head, polled for at most 10 minutes; never on another App's check.

# Owner Decisions 325717a6, 22b0e0ed and bc6fdad1: the scan runs on a GitHub-hosted runner with free
# minutes under the $0 Actions budget cap as an executor only. Its job name is not a required check
# name; App 5368905 publishes the required gitleaks check after it verifies this run's relay identity,
# and otherwise runs its formal local role.
# Owner Decision 22b0e0ed: admit on the independent CI's own App 5368905 kooyumi-work-admission
# check for this exact head, polled for at most 10 minutes; never on another App's check.
# The trusted base only: the pinned .gitleaks.toml, the reviewed-finding helper and the
# temporary-storage action come from main, never from the pull request.
# Exactly the input of the local formal role (worker/formal-gitleaks-v4/required-history/
# prepare.mjs): a fresh Git directory with no checkout, holding the fresh remote heads and tags,
# the detached current head and the pinned reviewed commits (objects only, never refs), with
# only the pinned .gitleaks.toml beside it. No .gitattributes, .gitleaksignore or other file of
# the pull request is read: the scan sees history as data, with no attributes of any tree.
export LC_ALL=C GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1
# The scanned head is the second parent of the merge commit this run belongs to.
for indirect in shallow info/grafts objects/info/alternates objects/info/http-alternates logs; do test ! -e "$repo/.git/$indirect"; done
- name: Validate exact historical exceptions and detection regressions
# The local role's container (worker/verify-once/verify-worker.mjs createArguments) and argv

- name: Scan complete history with Gitleaks 8.30.1
# Owner Decisions 325717a6, 22b0e0ed and bc6fdad1: the scans run on a GitHub-hosted runner with free
# minutes under the $0 Actions budget cap as an executor only. Its job name is not a required check
# name; App 5368905 publishes the required trivy check after it verifies this run's relay identity,
# and otherwise runs its formal local role.
# Owner Decision 22b0e0ed: admit on the independent CI's own App 5368905 kooyumi-work-admission
# check for this exact head, polled for at most 10 minutes; never on another App's check.
# The local role's input refusals: only regular blobs (prepare-workspaces.py tree_modes_regular),
# no path with a backslash, colon or control character, at most 100000 paths (formal-trivy-v4
# snapshotTree), and no Java archive, which needs a Java DB the local role does not prepare
# (required-trivy-v3/plans.mjs). Such a tree is never scanned here, only locally.
- name: Refuse symlinks, submodules and other non-regular tree entries
if tr '\0' '\n' < "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-trivy-tree" | grep -Ev '^(100644|100755) blob [0-9a-f]{40}[[:space:]]' | grep -q .; then
echo "::error title=trivy-hosted-executor::the tree has a symlink, submodule or other non-regular entry"
echo "::error title=trivy-hosted-executor::a path has a backslash, colon or control character, or is too long"
echo "::error title=trivy-hosted-executor::a Java archive needs the Java DB the local role does not prepare"
# The local role scans a copy of the checked-out tree without .git (formal-trivy-v4 snapshotTree).
- name: Snapshot the tree for the scanners
# Cache preparation exactly as the local role (required-trivy-v3/plans.mjs databasePreparationPlan
# and checksPreparationPlan, formal-trivy-v3/docker.mjs cacheCreateArguments): the only networked

# tag. A different digest, version or a stale DB fails the job.
- name: Prepare the vulnerability DB and the pinned checks bundle

read_back "$db" /bin/cat /cache/db/metadata.json | python3 -I -B -c 'import json,sys,time; m=json.load(sys.stdin); now=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", time.gmtime()); u, n = m["UpdatedAt"], m["NextUpdate"]; sys.exit(0 if m.get("Version") == 2 and u.endswith("Z") and n.endswith("Z") and u[:19] <= now < n[:19] else 1)'

read_back "$checks" /bin/cat /cache/policy/metadata.json | python3 -I -B -c 'import json,sys; m=json.load(sys.stdin); sys.exit(0 if m.get("Digest") == sys.argv[1] and m.get("MajorVersion") == 2 and m.get("CustomBuild") is not True else 1)' "$CHECKS_DIGEST"
